## Lab 4: Unit Testing with pytest
## Objectives
In this lab you practise writing small, independent unit tests.
## Setup
- Create a virtual environment for the lab.
- Install pytest version 8 or newer in that environment.
- Clone the starter repository from the course page.
## Tasks
- Write at least five unit tests for the function parse_date in dates.py.
- Each test must check exactly one behaviour and have a descriptive name.
- Add a test that checks parse_date raises ValueError for the input 31/02/2024.
- Use pytest.mark.parametrize for the tests of valid dates.
- Measure statement coverage and reach at least 80 % for dates.py.
- You may also add property-based tests with Hypothesis for extra credit.
## Rules
- Do not change the code in dates.py; only add tests.
- All tests must run with the single command pytest -q.
## Hand-in
- The tests folder as a ZIP file.
- A screenshot of the coverage report.
## Assessment
| Criterion | Marks |
|---|---|
| Tests for valid dates | 4 |
| Test for the invalid date | 2 |
| Coverage of at least 80 % | 2 |
| Test names and structure | 2 |
Total: 10 marks
